spec_match.rationale: Constructs three real AudioContexts with renderSizeHint 'default'/'hardware'/256 and reads back renderQuantumSize, baseLatency, and outputLatency — precisely the surface chromestatus/the Web Audio spec name.

interactive.rationale: Run benchmark performs the real construction and measurement on click — CDP-verified in Chromium 141: all three panels populated (128 frames / 10.00 ms / 32.00 ms each).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a default-vs-hardware output-latency comparison; the page runs exactly that comparison and explains how to read it.

edge_cases.rationale: On pre-support browsers all three columns silently show identical values with no 'hint not honoured here' banner, and renderQuantumSize being unexposed is indistinguishable from a genuine 128 readout.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 and the spec's renderSizeHint anchor, plus siblings.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite is well-guarded (accepts-integer/default/hardware, OfflineAudioContext acceptance, default-128-or-clean-fallback) and honestly passes 7/7 here because construction accepts the option even where the quantum is not yet configurable.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Benchmark driven via CDP with clean console; in Chromium 141 the hint has no effect, so only the identical-values degradation path — not a real hardware-hint divergence — was observable.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Panels and metric readouts use the shared variables; run button inherits the global button styling.

accessibility.rationale: Single native run button, but nine metric values update with no live region and panel headings are divs rather than headings.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured clean at 360x740 (scrollWidth 360; wide readouts confined to scrollable containers); desktop verified via screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Say so when the hint is not honoured
openQuestions.detail: In browsers without the OT/feature (like this Chromium 141) the three panels show identical 128/10ms/32ms with no explanation. Detect ctx.renderQuantumSize === undefined (or all-equal readings) and show the render-size-explorer-style banner ('renderQuantumSize not exposed — needs the origin trial / Chrome 153') so identical numbers are not read as a null result of the benchmark.

openQuestions.title: Announce benchmark results
openQuestions.detail: Wrap the three result panels (or a summary line) in aria-live=polite so the measured latencies are announced after the run.

summary: Real API, real measurements, real click-to-run — CDP-verified populating all three contexts in this pre-support browser (identical 128-frame readings, the honest degradation). Needs an explicit 'hint not honoured here' banner so that degradation is legible, and a live region for results. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
